**sdd/issue-256-b2/tasks**

**What**: Wrote `openspec/changes/issue-256-b2/tasks.md` — ordered TDD checklist for B2 Half 1 (the Antigravity harness adapter). 7 phases: (1) `compileAgentsMd()` pure fn + `SOURCE_DOCS` RED→GREEN, (2) `antigravity.mjs#init()` seam-injected wrapper + n=3 dispatch confirm, (3) generate real `AGENTS.md` + `antigravity.drift.test.mjs` byte-equality guard, (4) `governance.ignoreList` literal `'AGENTS.md'` + extended doctrine comment in `diff-size-count.mjs` + `governance-ignorelist.test.mjs` assertion (implements owner ruling #601, not reopened), (5) `managed-paths.mjs` literal + confirm no test requires backend files listed explicitly, (6) baptism runbook doc (`runbook-baptism.md`) — Fork A settings.json TO-VERIFY + rollback + hygiene rules + composition caveat — doc only, Half 2 not executed, (7) gate baseline + CP-B2 stop-and-declare including the ONE mandatory inaugural human/reviewer read of AGENTS.md (#601 Pin 4).

**Why**: User request to break issue-256-b2 spec+design into an ordered TDD tasks.md, encoding all locked decisions from spec.md (REQ-B2-1..6), design.md (init() shape, COMPILE Fork 5, drift-guard, Fork A, managed-paths, budget), and engram constraints #601 (owner ruling on AGENTS.md ignoreList classification) + #604 (measurements).

**Where**: `/home/gandalf/IA/brain/openspec/changes/issue-256-b2/tasks.md` (new). Read-only refs during research: `brain/scripts/harness/backends/plain.mjs`, `gentle-ai.mjs`, `plain.test.mjs`, `brain/core/managed-paths.mjs`, `managed-paths.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs`, `brain/scripts/lib/governance-ignorelist.test.mjs`, `brain.config.json`, `brain/core/config-migrations.mjs`, `brain/core/methodology/agent-authorities.md`, `workflow-governance.md`, `brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs` (GOVERNANCE_JOBS), and prior tasks.md precedent `openspec/changes/issue-250-b0/tasks.md` for house format (Review Workload Forecast table shape, Open Items, Out of scope sections).

**Learned**: Confirmed via direct read that `managed-paths.test.mjs` has NO assertion requiring backend files be listed as explicit literals (glob-coverage via `brain/scripts/**` is proven via `matchesAny`, following the `home-index.mjs` REQ-7 precedent) — resolves design's open question, no new literal needed for `antigravity.mjs` itself. Also confirmed `**/*.golden.json` (B1's ignoreList literal) is NOT part of `config-migrations.mjs`'s 0.4.0 shipped default — it was hand-added directly to this repo's own `brain.config.json` as this-repo-local policy; `AGENTS.md`'s classification (#601) follows the same pattern, must NOT be added to the migration defaults. Review Workload Forecast recalculated post-#601: risk dropped from design's pre-classification Medium-High (~270-370 total) to LOW (~150-205) once AGENTS.md itself became budget-free via ignoreList.
